questions.question: The sum of a positive number and its cube is 10. What is the value of the number?
questions.solution:
**Given****:**

Sum of a positive number and its cube = 10

**Calculation:**

Let the positive number be x, then

According to the question

x + x³ = 10

With the help of options put x = 2

2 + 2³ = 10

⇒ 2 + 8 = 10

⇒ 10 = 10 (satisfied)

∴ Now we can say the positive number is 2.

What is the Highest Common Factor of 14, 42 and 84?
questions.solution:
**Given****:**

The given number is 14, 42, 84

**Concept:**

The HCF of two or more than two numbers is the greatest number that divides each of them exactly.

**Calculation:**

14 = 2 × 7

42 = 2 × 3 × 7

84 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 7

HCF of 14, 42, 84 ⇒

⇒ 2 × 7

⇒ 14

questions.question: If 80% of P = 2/5 of Q, then what is P : Q?
questions.solution:
**Given****:**

80% of P = 2/5 of Q

**Formula:**

x% of a number = Actual number × (x/1000)

**Calculation:**

80% of P = 2/5 of Q

⇒ P × (80/100) = Q × (2/5)

⇒ P × (4/5) = Q × (2/5)

⇒ P/Q = (2/5) × (5/4)

⇒ P/Q = 1/2

∴ P : Q = 1 : 2

questions.question: 12 persons have Rs. 49 on an average. If a person with Rs. 55.5 join them, then what will be the new average (in Rs)?
questions.solution:
**Given****:**

Average money of 12 persons = Rs. 49

13th person has = Rs. 55.5

**Formula:**

Average = Sum of all observations/total number of al observations

**Calculation:**

Sum of money of all 12 persons = 49 × 12 = 588

Sum of money of all 13 persons = 643.5

∴ Average of money of 13 persons = 643.5/13 = 49.5

questions.question: The ratio of the outer and the inner perimeter of a circular path is 14 : 11. If path is 15 meters wide, then what is the radius (in metres) of the inner circle?
questions.solution:
**Given****:**

Ratio of the outer and the inner perimeter of the a circular path = 14 : 11

Width of the path = 15 m

**Formula:**

Perimeter of the circle = 2 πr

**Calculation:**

Let the radius of outer and inner circle be R and r m, then

Circumference of outer circle = 2 πR

Circumference of inner circle = 2 πr

According to the question

2 πR/2 πr = 14/11

⇒ R/r = 14/11

⇒ R : r = 14x : 11x

Length of path (R – r) = 15 m

14x – 11x = 15

⇒ 3x = 15

⇒ x = 15/3

⇒ x = 5

∴ Radius of inner circle = 11x = 11 × 5 = 55

questions.question: A boat covers 20 km upstream and 40 km downstream distance in 4 hours, while it covers 70 km upstream and 60 km downstream distance in 10 hours. What is the speed (in km/hr) of the current?
questions.solution:
**Given****:**

Boat covers 20 km upstream and 40 km downstream = 4 hrs

Boat covers 70 km upstream and 60 km downstream = 10 hrs

**Formula:**

Speed = distance/time

If speed of boat and stream be x and y km/hr respectively, then

Downstream speed = (x + y) km/hr

Upstream speed = (x – y) km/hr

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of boat and current be x km/hr and y km/hr respectively.

According to the question

20/(x – y) + 40/(x + y) = 4

Let 1/(x + y) = a and 1/(x – y) = b, then

20b + 40a = 4

⇒ 5b + 10a = 1 ---- (1)

70/(x – y) + 60/(x + y) = 10

⇒ 70b + 60a = 10

⇒ 7b + 6a = 1 ---- (2)

Multiply by 7 in equation (1) and multiply by 5 in equation (2)

35b + 70a = 7 ---- (3)

35b + 30a = 5 ---- (4)

Subtract equation (4) in equation (3)

40a = 2

⇒ a = 2/40

⇒ a = 1/20

Put a = 1/20 in equation (1)

5b + 10 × (1/20) = 1

⇒ 5b + 1/2 = 1

⇒ 5b = 1 – 1/2

⇒ 5b = 1/2

⇒ b = 1/10

1/(x + y) = a

⇒ 1/(x + y) = 1/20

⇒ x + y = 20 ---- (5)

1/(x – y) = b

⇒ 1/(x – y) = 1/10

⇒ (x – y) = 10 ---- (6)

Add equation (5) and equation (6)

2x = 30

⇒ x = 15

Put x = 15 in equation (1)

15 + y = 20

⇒ y = 20 – 15

⇒ y = 5

∴ Speed of current is 5 km/hr.

questions.question: P started a business by investing Rs. 60000. After 4 months Q joined the business by Investing Rs. 80000. After 4 more months, R joined the business by investing Rs. 100000. What will be the ratio of profits of P, Q and R at end of 2 years?
questions.solution:
**Given****:**

P started a business by investing = Rs. 60000

After 4 months Q joined the business by investing = Rs. 80000

After 4 months R joined the business by investing = Rs. 100000

**Formula:**

Profit = Money × Time

**Calculation:**

Profit ratio of P, Q and R ⇒

⇒ 60000 × 24 : 80000 × 20 : 100000 × 16

⇒ 9 : 10 : 10

questions.question: S and V can do a work in 12 days. M and S can do the same work in 16 days. M and V can do the same work in 24 days. In how many days S, V and M together can complete the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given****:**

S and V together can complete a work in = 12 days

M and S together can complete the same work in = 16 days

M and V together can complete the same work in = 24 days

**Formula:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Total work = 48 unit (LCM of 12, 24 and 16)

Efficiency of S and V = 4 units/day

Efficiency of M and S = 3 units/day

Efficiency of M and V = 2 units/day

Efficiency of S, V and M = (4 + 3 + 2)/2 = 4.5 units/day

∴ Time taken by S, V and M to complete the whole work = 48/4.5 = 32/3 days
